title: Sessions views: pick a session layout (prototype ready)

owner_note.text: The session view is shown three ways on real 2026-10-20 sessions; I recommend A (inline), with places as paths and no Miller columns on the sessions pages. The alternatives are B (drop-down) and C (two panes), and nothing gets built until you pick.
